label: X3-profiles-3-5-cycling

events.result: all 5 profiles activate correctly via software (profile use 1-5)

events.note: binding must be written to ALL profiles for cycling to work across transitions

events.result: profile-cycle wraps from max back to 1
profile-plus clamps at maximum (stays at 5, no wrap)
profile-minus clamps at minimum (stays at 1, no wrap)
profile-cycle wraps within enabled range (1..max), does not escape to profiles 4-5
